title: Rav Acha bar Natan

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Chullin 49a according to Dikdukei Soferim, disagreeing with Mar Zutra son of Rav Mari; the text Hyman uses reads Rav Ada bar Natan. Hyman identifies Rav Mesharshiya as his son’s son.[^1]

notes.text: The consulted Chullin 49a paragraph names Rav Adda bar Natan and Mar Zutra bar Rav Mari. Hyman’s Acha reading attributed to Dikdukei Soferim and his grandson identification remain reports; the apparatus and genealogy were not independently collated or admitted.
